question: Even if it is not required, would you prefer one method that both locks your message and checks for changes?
example: Some options use one standard design for both jobs. Others combine an encryption method with a separate check. Would you prefer the first approach?

question: If checking the sending time is optional, would you prefer to leave out that extra step?
example: A timestamp stores when a message was sent and makes the receiver check the time. If you do not need that check, would you prefer an option without it?

question: Even if it is not required, would you prefer to encrypt several parts of a file at once?
example: Imagine a large file split into parts. Some methods can lock several parts at the same time. Would you prefer that ability, even if your application can work without it?
